note: cf_problem taxonomy. Category names are EXISTING Zoho picklist values (reuse, not rename) so AI suggestions write back without fragmenting the picklist; 'Codes' is the only new value. `description` text is fed to the AI classifier — keep it discriminative. See docs/problem-taxonomy.md.

categories.name: Spam
categories.description: Non-actionable junk: phishing, bot/garbage messages, AND automated OTA/channel booking notifications (Vrbo, Hotels.com, Airbnb) such as 'Reservation request from…', 'Instant Booking from…', or 'guest message from…'. NOTE: unsolicited marketing/sales pitches aimed AT RoverPass go to 'Marketing', not here. EXCEPTION: verification/login codes (e.g. Channex) are NOT spam — use 'Codes'.

categories.name: Duplicate Ticket
categories.description: A repeat of another ticket from the same customer about the same issue, or an auto-generated duplicate.

categories.name: CS/Product Test
categories.description: Internal test tickets, CS/product QA, or tickets a park already resolved themselves. No customer action needed.

categories.name: Training/Feature Questions
categories.description: Customer asking how to use a feature, where to find something, or how to do a task in RoverPass. Educational 'how do I...' questions.

categories.name: Saas Subscription - update
categories.description: Changes to the RoverPass SaaS subscription/plan, contract terms, pausing the account, or ownership/account transfer (not cancellation). ALSO covers the park's OWN RoverPass subscription billing — e.g. a failed auto-payment on their RoverPass plan, or updating their subscription payment info (we check/update it in Zoho billing).

categories.name: Cancel RoverPass Account
categories.description: Customer wants to cancel their RoverPass account, is churning, or an exit interview / unhappy-with-terms conversation.

categories.name: Add/update user
categories.description: Add/remove/update a user, password resets, or W9/document status. Access and identity issues. (For automated verification/login CODES from integration platforms, use 'Codes'.)

categories.name: Codes
categories.description: Verification / 2FA / login codes sent by an integration platform (e.g. Channex) or any platform sending us a code. Actionable — leave the ticket OPEN so someone can use the code.

categories.name: Rate/Site/Details Update
categories.description: Updating a campground listing's details, rates, site info, store/products, availability, blackout dates, or adding a new listing.

categories.name: Extra Map Revisions
categories.description: Requests to add, change, or revise the campground site map.

categories.name: Cancellation/Refund
categories.description: Customer or camper requesting a refund — cancellation refunds or platform-fee refunds.

categories.name: Payout Update/Issue
categories.description: Payouts to the park and camper-payment issues at the park (failed camper payments, duplicate charges, collections/finance). NOT the park's own RoverPass subscription payment — that is 'Saas Subscription - update'. Not refunds or disputes.

categories.name: Invoice issue
categories.description: Invoice questions/issues, fee questions or complaints, marketplace fee questions, or tax information.

categories.name: Stripe Dispute
categories.description: Stripe chargebacks/disputes, Stripe identity verification, or a rejected Stripe account.

categories.name: Reservation Adjustment
categories.description: Adjusting an existing reservation or editing camper/guest info on a booking.

categories.name: Camper Cannot Complete Reservation
categories.description: A camper is unable to complete/finish a booking (errors, timeouts). Tracked as a bug — this SPECIFIC category wins over generic 'Bug' for booking-completion failures.

categories.name: Camper - General Inquiry (Should have gone to campground)
categories.description: A general camper question that should have gone to the campground directly, not RoverPass support.

categories.name: Trip Insurance Question/Cancellation
categories.description: Questions about, or cancellation of, trip insurance.

categories.name: Channel Management Inquiry
categories.description: Channel manager / Channex questions or issues, including rate & availability sync between RoverPass and external channels.

categories.name: Bug
categories.description: A software bug, something broken, or an edit that requires a developer (incl. email-notification malfunctions). NOTE: if a camper specifically cannot complete a booking, use 'Camper Cannot Complete Reservation' instead.

categories.name: Reports Issue
categories.description: Problems with reports, or requests for custom/customized reporting.

categories.name: Waivers
categories.description: Anything about waivers.

categories.name: Potential Lead
categories.description: A potential sales lead, or a lead contacting support that should be routed to Sales (incl. button-recovery calls).

categories.name: Upsell Oportunity
categories.description: An upsell opportunity — customer is inquiring about or interested in EXISTING products/add-ons.

categories.name: New Feature Outreach
categories.description: WE proactively reach out to a park to promote or announce a feature (outbound from RoverPass).

categories.name: Product Feature Desired
categories.description: The customer requests a NEW feature/capability that does NOT already exist.

categories.name: RRS-CRS Upsell
categories.description: An upsell specifically for RRS / CRS products.

categories.name: Marketing
categories.description: Marketing-related: unsolicited marketing/sales pitches aimed AT RoverPass (e.g. directory or SaaS solicitations), plus RoverPass's own marketing outreach, content, or requests.

categories.name: Park still in OB
categories.description: Park is still in onboarding (OB), a call answered by the onboarding team, or welcome-packet related.

categories.name: Account Check in
categories.description: Proactive check-in by the Account Management team. Strictly account management — not a post-call email follow-up.

categories.name: Review Complaint
categories.description: Customer doesn't like a camper review and wants it removed or addressed.

categories.name: Missed Phone Call Follow-Up Email
categories.description: We received a phone call and are checking in over email to ask if they still need help. A post-call email follow-up.

categories.name: At Risk Check In
categories.description: A check-in specifically with an at-risk account.

categories.name: Training Call Follow-Up Email
categories.description: A follow-up email sent after a training call.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Genuine requests that fit no other category: misc product inquiries (CRS/RRS/ticketing/marketplace listing checks), chatbot tickets, surveys, or domain renewals. Use only when nothing else fits.
